title: Cold shader preparation under exact presentation caching
decision: Reject sampled-catalog rollout as the next sustained 720p60 fix. Cold spikes disappear and Battlefield improves modestly, but Fountain cadence has no repeatable gain and exhaustive roster/costume coverage is unproved. Restore all experimental runtime/harness/test/contract changes; existing constructor prewarming remains available.
scope: Two localhost Chromium clients on one host, cold Mesa shader cache, 960x720 native picture in 1280x720 presentation. Compile-containing draw interval overlap with capture receipt gaps is correlation, not exact missing-frame attribution or physical latency.
